prompt_en: A richly detailed magical-world photographic scene of a fictional adult witch-artisan calibrating a potion in a stone laboratory. The supplied reference guides her face and black bob with fine fringe: retain the brown eyes, narrow straight nose, natural pink lip shape and small cheek beauty mark. Seated at a worn stone workbench, she leans a little forward with relaxed shoulders, eyes lowered toward the liquid and lips gently parted in concentration. Her right hand holds one slender tapering wooden wand between thumb and curled fingers; the forearm extends naturally beside the pot, and the wand tip hovers just above the liquid. A small pale-blue glimmer at the tip traces a circular ripple directly beneath it. Her left hand lies palm-down on the bench clear of the hot vessel, its fingers relaxed. The open black cast-iron cauldron has a round belly, a rolled rim, two loop handles on opposite sides and three short feet resting on the stone; blue liquid and a thin rising steam plume are visible within its opening. A freestanding brass temperature dial stands beyond the pot. Her long-sleeved black wizarding robe falls open at the collar, exposing an emerald-green inner facing edged in narrow silver braid. A palm-sized golden pendant lies flat at the centre of her chest, its fine neck chain joining the pendant's upper bail. Three separately readable nested rings encircle one upright transparent hourglass at the pendant's centre, the glass pinched to a narrow waist with sand collected in its lower bulb. A three-quarter waist-up portrait includes her face, both hands and the complete cauldron, photographed from slightly above bench height so the liquid surface is readable. Warm window light caresses her cheek and the gold pendant while the cool potion glow softly touches the wand hand. The face, tip-to-ripple relationship and hourglass are crisp; the stone wall and tall reagent shelves recede gently behind her.
